$comment: The inventory of the five handwritten real-world reports, 105-109, that the brief's P5 asks for with 105's migration (llm-dlc/loops/example-targets-positive.md). Read from each folder's example.json and README.md on 2026-11-14; nothing in 106-109 was edited, rerun or re-derived. 'historical' quotes each example's own verdictLabel: an authored label of a run made before this wave, never a receipt, and never counted as a result of the new route. 'sources' is what each README names, not checked against upstream here (105's are, in sources.lock.json). 'thisWave' says what the migration does with it.

examples.recorded: JBMC 6.11.0 through /verify-bytecode, 2026-11-01, ArithmeticUtils.java compiled alone; rerun the same day with the same verdicts. pow(long,int) not covered.
examples.sources: merge 8cfc04e8 onto e7c172d2, pull request head 79aa4643: resolved afresh and checked (sources.lock.json)
